UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user statistics and unlocked badges.

uid.description: The unique ID of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

photoURL.description: The URL of the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the profile was created.

longestStreak.description: The longest streak achieved by the user in days.

totalRelapses.description: The total number of relapses logged by the user.

badges.description: A list of unlocked badge IDs.

id.description: The unique ID of the streak.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this streak.

startDate.description: The timestamp when the streak started.

endDate.description: The timestamp when the streak ended (if relapsed).

status.description: The current status of the streak.

relapseReason.description: The reason provided for the relapse.

duration.description: The duration of the streak in milliseconds.

CommunityPost.title: Community Post
CommunityPost.description: A post shared by a user in the community feed.

id.description: The unique ID of the post.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created the post.

username.description: The anonymous or display name of the user.

streakDays.description: The number of days in the user's current streak at the time of posting.

likes.description: A list of user IDs who liked the post.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the post was created.
